name: KAO Master Command Hub
tag: One dashboard to watch and manage appliances across all your sites.

scenarios.title: Bring a fleet online
scenarios.ask: Connect {sites} sites with about {per} appliances each. Most use {proto}.
steps: Discovery
Found {=sites * per} appliances and grouped them by site and type.
Connector
Set up {proto} connectors. {=round(sites * per * 0.06)} devices need a firmware update first.
Mapper
Mapped readings like power, temperature and run hours to one standard format.
Dashboard
Built a site map with live status and a fleet health score.
followups: Can it control devices or only watch them?
Both. Control actions like restarts or set-point changes need a named approver unless you allow them for a device type.
What if a site loses internet?
A small local gateway keeps logging and sends the data when the link returns.

scenarios.title: Find an energy spike
scenarios.ask: Power use jumped {jump} last week across {devices} appliances. Find out why.
steps: Analyzer
Compared last week to the 4 weeks before across {devices} appliances.
Finder
{=max(1, round(devices * 0.04))} units account for most of the jump. Most are walk-in coolers.
Cause
Their compressors run {=round(jump * 2.5)}% longer than normal. Door seal or coil fouling is likely.
Work orders
Drafted {=max(1, round(devices * 0.04))} inspection orders for approval.

result.title: Spike explained
rows: Sample monthly cost of the spike

followups: It is the most likely cause from the run-time pattern. A technician confirms it on site, and the result trains future alerts.
Can we get alerted sooner next time?
Yes. Set a threshold and any unit drifting more than a set amount from its normal pattern is flagged within a day.

scenarios.title: Plan preventive maintenance
scenarios.ask: We have {units} units and about {fail} fail each year. Plan maintenance to cut that.
steps: History
Read 2 years of alarms and repair notes.
Risk model
Ranked units by failure risk. {=round(units * 0.1)} are in the top risk group.
Scheduler
Grouped visits by site so one technician trip covers several units.
Forecast
Estimated failures after the plan settles in.
followups: Servicing the riskiest 10% first gives most of the benefit for the least technician time.
Does it work with our service company?
Yes. Work orders export to email, a spreadsheet or your service tool.
